diagnostic_evidence.quote: the left invariant subspace corresponding to the eigenvalues in the open unit disk of the sought solution $R$ is approximated by the span generated by the rows of $U_{2,2}^{(k)}$.

issues.failure_explanation: In an SVD $A=U\Sigma V^\top$, left singular vectors are the columns of $U$, not its rows. The trailing left singular subspace should therefore be extracted from trailing columns and transposed when represented as rows. Returning $T_R=U_2^{(k+1)}$ generally gives unrelated rows.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Partition $U_2^{(k)}$ by columns and define $T_R$ using the transpose of the selected trailing-column basis, adjusting the associated formulas consistently.

issues.title: Left singular vectors are used with the wrong orientation

issues.failure_explanation: The algorithm takes the first $\ell$ Schur vectors without specifying any ordering or criterion selecting one appropriate direction for each doubled eigenvalue $\mu_i$. Since every target eigenvalue occurs twice, an arbitrary generalized Schur decomposition may place both copies of some eigenvalues in the leading block and omit others, and its leading deflating subspace need not be the graph of the desired solvent; $Z_{11}$ is not guaranteed to be invertible.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, provide a mathematically justified construction selecting the unique graph deflating subspace associated with one copy of every $\mu_i$ and prove its leading block is invertible.

issues.title: QZ algorithm does not select the required deflating subspace
issues.why_classification: Ordinary eigenvalue ordering cannot distinguish the duplicated copies, so a new subspace-selection argument or construction is required at the core of the reduced solver.

issues.failure_explanation: From a selected graph subspace $Z_1=[Z_{11}^\top,Z_{21}^\top]^\top$, the solvent is $Z_{21}Z_{11}^{-1}$. The Schur relations do not replace the graph basis $Z_{11}$ by the unrelated block $Q_{11}$, and they also yield the restriction using the order $S_{11}^{-1}T_{11}$, not $T_{11}S_{11}^{-1}$.
